changes.title: Can Ancient Ruins Be Protected From Wildfires? Greece Is Trying.
changes.summary: As blazes surge across Europe, the country is making a trade-off to protect its heritage by fireproofing sites at the risk of spoiling the surrounding landscape.

changes.title: China or the U.S.? Two Meetings Offer Competing Showcases of Global Power.
changes.summary: As Xi Jinping gathered with the leaders of Russia and Iran, Europe challenged the Trump administration at the G20, offering a split-screen view of a changing world.

changes.title: Bessent reportedly tells Russia no economic relief until Ukraine war ends as Europe snubs Moscow at G20
changes.summary: The meeting underscored Washington's willingness to reopen diplomatic talks with Moscow, as Europe intends to isolate the nation while the war continues.

changes.title: France's top court blocks under-15 social media ban, citing constitutional freedoms
changes.summary: France last month became the first country in the European Union to pass a blanket ban on the platforms amid rising worldwide concerns about the harmful effects of digital content on kids.

changes.title: Greece toughens stance on illegal migration with new deportation plan
changes.summary: Eleven years into a migration crisis, Greece is trying to stop boats crossing from North Africa to the Greek island of Crete. changes.summary: As summer temperatures soar across the United States and Europe, cities are being forced to confront the difficult reality that they're getting dangerously hot.

changes.title: More Wildfires and Extreme Heat Roil Europe, but Relief Is on the Horizon
changes.summary: Another day of near record heat baked the continent on Friday, but temperatures could retreat to seasonal averages in the coming days.

changes.title: As Europe Gets Hotter, Its Transportation Systems Struggle to Cope
changes.summary: The continent’s railways and roads “were engineered for a climate that no longer exists,” one expert said.
